audio.quiet_preview.claim: Untested after the required wake sequence; the pre-wake volume query returned an empty payload before playback.

battery.state_voltage.claim: Firmware battery state and voltage queries succeeded repeatedly, including after wake.

ble.connect_disconnect.claim: Five fresh cycles and a 30-minute stationary session completed with clean disconnects.

collision.configuration.claim: The pinned adapter advertises collision configuration; the actual firmware behavior has not been exercised.

drive.bounded_calibration.claim: Four separately armed forward pulses (two immediate post-wake at speed 5 and two after a three-second wake settle at speed 10) queued through the reviewed nonblocking path, but the operator observed no displacement; transport delivery and motor response remain unconfirmed.

emergency_stop.physical.claim: No moving emergency-stop effectiveness test has been performed.

head.position_read.claim: Untested after the required wake sequence; the pre-wake read timed out.

led.dome_logic_display.claim: The bounded dome LED sequence completed after wake and was physically observed.

stop.command_acknowledgement.claim: The final OFF/0 safe-hold command received a response after wake; physical stopping effectiveness was not measured.

stop.physical_effectiveness.claim: Stopping time and distance have not been measured from locomotion.

telemetry.stationary.claim: Sensor streams are advertised by the adapter but have not been exercised on this firmware.

wake.stance_cycle.claim: Wake was acknowledged and physically observed cycling three-leg to two-leg stance without locomotion.
